entityDescription:
Hans-Christoph Steiner been working with Guardian Project https://guardianproject.info/ for over a decade, on privacy in the mobile context and has been involved in the ideas, development, and UX design of Tor embedded in Android, private messaging with ChatSecure, untrackable software distribution with F-Droid, and more. He is also part of the core team of the F-Droid decentralized app distribution ecosystem; and a Tor Core Contributor, focusing on Tor on Android, and Tor integrations. He has been a Debian Developer since 2012, where he founded and still leads the Android Tools Team for including the Android SDK and related auditing and inspection tools.
ProofMode (https://proofmode.org) is a system that enables authentication and verification of multimedia content, particularly captured on a smartphone, from point of capture at the source to viewing by a recipient. It utilizes enhanced sensor-driven metadata, hardware fingerprinting, cryptographic signing, and third-party notaries to enable a pseudonymous, decentralized approach to the need for chain-of-custody and “proof” by both activists, journalists, documentarians, and everyday people alike. ProofMode is an open-source project developed by Guardian Project for over 10 years.
Rivka Karasik, a passionate privacy enthusiast with a background in art and education, has been working with Hans-Christoph Steiner on projects related to free software and tracking detection and awareness. They recently completed work on two European based projects together: "Tracking the Trackers" funded by NLnet PETO and "The Search for Ethical Apps" funded by NLnet NG10Discovery. Rivka Karasik has also been working together with the F-Droid community on the creation of a board and statutes. She also works with Guardian Project on various F-Droid and related projects.
atorat KG, established in September of 2022, and based in Vienna, Austria represents the working partnership of Hans-Christoph Steiner and Rivka Karasik. It also represents Guardian Project on projects in Europe.
The funding we are pursuing with the ESA is focused on engaging citizen science, gamification, and open standards and services for geolocation and mapping. These are all highly relevant to our work on ProofMode, and activities that we already have underway. atorat KG is the EU representative of Guardian Project's work on ProofMode that will be the managing entity for this application.

entityDescription:
Villinger GmbH is an Austrian SME founded in 1989, specialized in the following fields:
- Beyond state-of-the-art air disinfection systems based on our unique LEA™ technology
- Highly energy efficient thermal control systems to keep equipment above temperature limits
 
Air Disinfection Systems
Together with an international consortium of medical engineers and doctors, our patented LEA™ (Laminar Electrode Array) technology features beyond state-of-the-art air disinfecting capabilities, without producing ozone or nitrogen oxide as byproducts. LEA™ is capable of removal but also immediate inactivation of airborne particles including viruses, bacteria, mold, fungi, pollen, VOCs and dust. During laboratory tests, using aerosolized MS2 bacteriophage with particle sizes ranging from 0.1µm – 0.5µm, LEA™ yielded an average 6.09 +/- 0.03 net LOG reduction, which corresponds to an average 99.99992% reduction rate of airborne MS2 virus particles. LEA™ may be installed as a stand-alone technology or to support HEPA/ULPA filters within the ECLS unit.
 
Thermal Control Systems
Utilizing our unique heating technology based on electrically conductive coatings, we offer highly energy efficient surface heating systems in order to keep various spacecraft and space station components, i.e. battery packs, above temperature limits.

entityDescription: A.S. Prote Maritime Ltd is an innovative technology SME founded in Cyprus in 2013 and subsequently expanded through theestablishment of an official branch in Greece. The company operates in the fields of security, maritime surveillance, criticalinfrastructure protection, environmental monitoring and advanced unmanned systems. Our primary focus is the development anduse of autonomous vehicles in the maritime environment.The company currently employs six highly qualified professionals and complements its capabilities through project-basedcollaborations and external experts according to project requirements. Our personnel's experience is demonstrating 30+ years inthe Hellenic War Navy, 12+ years in the Merchant Navy and 15+ years in Higher Education (Virtual Reality).Since its creation, the company has invested continuously in proprietary UAV technologies. We are holding a patent granted by theHellenic Industrial Property Organization entitled “Marine Area Surveillance System Using Unmanned Aircraft Systems to Avoidand Prevent Merchant Ships from Piracy” (International Classification: B64C 39/02, B64D 47/00, G06Q 50/10, G06V 10/10). Thisinnovation demonstrates the company’s capability to develop UAV-based solutions addressing maritime security challenges.Building on this foundation, we developed the PHORCYS UAV platform for maritime surveillance, inspection and securityapplications. Through theseactivities, our company has accumulated significant expertise in UAV systems engineering, autonomous operations,communications, sensor integration, simulation and maritime-domain applications.The knowledge, technological assets and intellectual property generated through these activities support the commercialexploitation of ΛIMHN, our next-generation UAV platform for surveillance, inspection, environmental monitoring, criticalinfrastructure protection and port and anchorage operations.

description:
Radtest Ltd provides a comprehensive portfolio of radiation testing services across a wide range of sectors where exposure to ionising radiation may be encountered. For space customers, we offer TID, TNID and SEE testing, combined with thermal and vacuum environments. Our own walk-in cobalt-60 irradiation facility routinely accommodates multiple samples at various dose rates. Regular slots for heavy ion beam time ensure that projects do not need to wait long for testing. All aspects of the test process (sample procurement, package preparation, test plans, test hardware and software, data acquisition, hands-on testing, data analysis and reporting) can be included.

We are proud to be the only test house outside the USA to be awarded DLA laboratory suitability for total dose testing under all test conditions defined in MIL-STD-750 and MIL-STD-883 test method 1019 including test condition A.

Our SEREEL2 is now an established product for pulsed laser SEE testing. This provides an alternative to heavy ion testing, affording rapid access to data for screening, fault injection studies and comparative testing. SEREEL2 uses only the most reliable, stable and industrially proven components (lasers, movement stages and optics) to deliver a high quality experience for users.

entityDescription: The University of Zilina was established as the Railway College on 1st September 1953 by the separation from the Czech Technical University in Prague. It has gone through numerous changes during its history. Finally, in 1996, it was renamed from the University of Transport and Communications to the University of Zilina in ¿ilina. The University as a public university provides education at all three levels of higher education (Bachelor¿s degree, Engineer/Master¿s degree and Doctoral degree) in both full-time and part-time forms. So far approximately 63 000 graduates have finished their studies (1800 graduates from abroad) at the University. Approximately 11 000 students currently study in all forms of study. There are more than 1 500 employees and 650 of them are university teachers. With its more than a half-century history, the University has taken a prominent place in the Slovak educational space not only with the number of its students, with the range of accredited study programmes, but also with its scientific and foreign activities based on cooperation with domestic and foreign companies and institutions. In the field of science and research, individual working places of the University have been involved in solving of more than 150 scientific and research projects financially supported from public sources through countrywide grant schemes in the sum of 2,1 mil EUR. Currently, scientific teams have been working on 35 projects supported from abroad, mainly within the EU 6th and 7th Framework Programmes. Except for solving project tasks, the issues of quality technical equipment of experimental working places and increasing quality of human sources have been monitored. Scientific teams closely cooperate with partners from various industrial branches in the applied research. 6 centres of excellence are supported via the Operational Programme ¿Research and Development¿ within the framework of structural funds. The University is also involved in 4 projects solved by centres of competence within this Operational Programme. There have been created 3 centres of the applied research. Achievements are presented mainly through publication activities, submitted applications for patents, presentations at international scientific symposiums and conferences, but also at trade fairs and exhibitions. Cooperation with foreign universities enables students and teachers to participate actively in international educational and research projects (LLP/ERASMUS, Grundvig, Comenius, TEMPUS, COST, CEEPUS, the 6th and 7th Framework Programmes, etc.). The University belongs to the most active universities in the Lifelong Learning Programme ¿ LLP. Within its ERASMUS Programme, the University ¿ as the only one in Slovakia - has been listed among 40 most successful universities of the EU in the field of teacher mobility for a ten year period. As for the number of outgoing ERASMUS students and the number of teaching staff mobilities, the University has one of the prominent positions among Slovak universities participating in the Programme.

entityDescription:
The Institute of Agriculture and Tourism, with its 145 years of continuous organised work, is one of the oldest-running scientific research institutions in the Republic of Croatia. From its foundation until today, the Institute has become a scientific research institution that has significantly contributed to the development of agriculture and tourism, at the regional as well as national level. Acting regionally, but with national and international recognition, through a number of realised domestic and international projects, the Institute nurtures the fundamental role and goals for which it was founded: rural development with emphasis on agriculture and tourism, acquisition and transfer of knowledge, affirmation of scientific research and professional activities in agriculture and tourism, and preservation of biodiversity, as well as natural and traditional values. Nowadays, in the time of indispensable interdisciplinary, necessary competitiveness and the need to create lasting cooperation and international relations, the Institute of Agriculture and Tourism can rightly be considered one of the leading scientific research institutions in the field of agriculture and tourism in Croatia, as well as one of the few institutions in the world with such research symbiosis. We firmly believe that the Institute will remain a strong and respectable scientific research organisation, primarily in the environment in which it operates, but at the same time will still be recognised and respected nationally and internationally, as a centre of knowledge for rural development, agriculture and sustainable tourism. We also believe that the aspirations of the Institute's employees go further, constantly surpassing the current scientific and research achievements.

Main organizational units

DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE AND NUTRITION
DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMICS AND AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT
DEPARTMENT OF TOURISM
Other organizational units
EXPERIMENTAL AGRICULTURAL ESTATE
TECHNOLOGIAL DEVELOPMENT CENTRE
